description: Categorical-fill component tag contract. The component selects one semantic case from a reusable presentation-level classification scheme; trusted RGB styling is resolved by the renderer and is never generated by AI.

efficio_component_type.description: Identifies this shape or native PowerPoint group as a categorical-fill component.

efficio_classification_scheme_id.description: References one scheme_id from the presentation-level efficio_classification_schemes registry.

efficio_fill_mode.description: Classification chooses one case for the complete component. Selection colors declared child items using selected and unselected cases. Missing mode means classification.

efficio_fill_selection.description: Required only for selection mode. Declares two semantic cases and the item IDs mapped to child shapes in the native PowerPoint group.

efficio_selection_item_id.description: Child-shape marker for an item inside a selection group. Place it on the child target, not on the owning component group. It does not make the child a standalone component.

example.efficio_prompt_instruction: Classify the German market using German evidence only.
